==Usage==
This template should be placed before the actual interview request on archived pages from [[Wookieepedia]]'s [[Wookieepedia:Interview and creator interaction policy|interview and creator interaction policy]]. To use this template, copy and paste one of the following:
*<code><nowiki>{{subst:InterviewArchive|successful}}</nowiki></code> or <code><nowiki>{{subst:InterviewArchive}}</nowiki></code> for successful interview requests, or
*<code><nowiki>{{subst:InterviewArchive|unsuccessful}}</nowiki></code> for unsuccessful interview requests.

Finally, add a <code><nowiki></div></nowiki></code> tag at the very end of the page.
